note: Ordinary two-column body page, 1750x2180 (ratio 0.803), not A4. No chapter banner and no page_header_band; the page DOES carry two thin red footer rules, one above and one below the asterisk footnote, reported as two separate footer_rule elements with fill #ed1c24 sampled from the flat middle of each rule. body_text_size_px measured on the left-column prose. UNSURE / most important caveat: block 5 ('An absorption spectrum is like the photographic negative of an emission spectrum...') is a single block that BREAKS ACROSS the column gutter - two lines at the foot of the left column and five more at the head of the right column. n:5 is placed on the left-column portion where the block begins; the right-column continuation is reported as the following element with n:null rather than repeating n:5, because a duplicated n would make a consumer render the same text twice. Heading levels: block 1 is the numbered sub-section '2.3.3', the highest-level heading on this page, so it is major_heading; blocks 3 and 9 are the unnumbered italic blue headings below it, so they are section_heading. Block 11 is the page-foot asterisk footnote; marginal_note is the nearest allowed role for a footnote (the input calls it a paragraph) and it spans the full measure, not one column. The last element is the bottom-centre edition line '2024-25', recorded as running_header for want of a footer-text role. The decorative_image is the diagonal 'NCERT / not to be republished' watermark; its bbox encloses a rotated object. Blocks 1-4 and 6-11 matched by position with no ambiguity.
